summary: Apply local OneDev and Validator publication to every repository by default

delivery.outcome: Local OneDev verification plus the independent Validator is the default publication route for every repository; an adopter may only narrow that default through .governance/local-ci-publication.json. Release and adopter re-pin follow in a dependent ticket.
nonGoals: Change OneDev or Validator runtime configuration
Re-pin the adopter reference copy (follow-up ticket after merge)
Modify downstream adopters without their own ticket
Bump VERSION or release; the dependent release ticket publishes 0.20.51

architecture.decision: Scope the local-CI transport rule to all repositories by default; a closed JSON schema lets an adopter declare an allowlist restriction, which only narrows where the rule is preferred and never grants authority.
architecture.rollback: Publish a later corrective standard version; never retag published releases.

validation.evidence: No org-limited scope sentence remains; adopter reference and AGENTS rule state the default.
Schema accepts mode all and restricted allowlists and rejects unknown fields.
